run_custom_blocks_command: run the custom_blocks CLI command to save a custom diffusers block module to the current directory
register_custom_blocks_subcommand: register the custom_blocks subcommand with argparse to accept block module name and class name arguments
get_class_names_from_file: parse a Python file with AST to find all classes inheriting from ModularPipelineBlocks
choose_block_by_name: select a specific custom block class from a list of candidate classes by name
create_automap_for_block: create an automap dictionary mapping a parent class to its child module and class name
